description: If \(i<b\), then \(m_R(\bar x,b)=i\) if and only if \(R(\bar x,i)\) holds and every smaller candidate fails.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch_eq_iff.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (R : α → ℕ → Prop) (x : α)
  (b i : ℕ) (hi : i < b) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSearch R x b = i ↔ R x i ∧ ∀ j < i, ¬R x j
